completion.summary: Added the Phase 3 E2E scenario: four agents in four worktrees, seeded random concurrent claims, locks, completes and edits, with interleaved merges. It checks for zero duplicate claims and zero lost records. A mutation that disables the claim conflict check makes it fail. pnpm test:e2e takes --repeat, --seed and --steps. CI's e2e job runs 10 seeds on every push and 100 nightly or on dispatch. The PLAN Gate box is still open: the 100-run job only works once ci.yml is on main. Also fixed CI: better-sqlite3 now uses its prebuilds (no node-gyp, which broke Windows), and the lock paging test timeout is raised.
